pages.title: Awards
pages.text: The $(item)Awards$() program reads your $(l:radiocraft:computer/book_editor)logbook$() (LOGBOOK.LOG, or F3 for another) and tracks operating awards. $(thing)Every contact counts$(): nothing needs confirming. Each award has levels; Enter shows what you have worked and what is still missing.

pages.title: The Awards
pages.text: Worked All Biomes, Worked All Dimensions, Worked All Bands (80, 40, 20, 10 and 2 m), Worked All Modes (phone, CW, RTTY, FT8, SSTV), the Contact Ladder, Stations Worked, Grid Chaser, Long Haul (the longest contact), Night Owl (contacts at night) and a ladder for each mode. F6 shows the distance records per band and per mode.

pages.title: Where They Were
pages.text: A station the logbook filled in from a radio is placed by the $(thing)grid square$() it was heard from (squares of 256 blocks), its dimension and the biome at the square's centre. An FT8 contact or a typed grid works the same. Distances are to the nearest 100 blocks. No exact positions are ever kept.

pages.title: Certificates
pages.text: F5 prints the selected award's certificate for the level you reached, on the $(l:radiocraft:computer/scanner)scanner$(): on paper or an empty map as a printout, on photo paper as a photo. Frame it.
A blank floppy and an item frame.
